summary: Guardian Booth's FAQ names 4 x 4 ft, 4 x 6 ft and 6 x 6 ft booth footprints (1.22 x 1.22, 1.22 x 1.83, 1.83 x 1.83 m) and recommends 4 x 6 ft for one person. The library piece uses the 4 x 6 ft footprint. The 2.4 m height is an ESTIMATE: the page excerpt gave no height. Page reported opened by a second research engine, not by Claude.

sources.title: Guardian Booth: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.note: Reported: 4 x 4 and 4 x 6 ft can be moved by 5 to 6 people; for two people the recommended size is 6 x 6 ft. Height not stated.
